items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: This was a date Harry put together in New York, and Cozy was leader on it

ctx.x: We were talking on the last reel the record date in which Cozy was the leader. about (inaudible).

That's right. This was a date Harry put together in New York, and Cozy was leader on it, and, as I mentioned, four of the guy -- guys in the group was Coleman Hawkins, Earl Hines, Billy Taylor on bass -- he's a bass player. I think he retired. He played with Duke once. And myself and Joe Thomas on trumpet, and it was a good date. We did one song I wrote, was "Through for the Night."
